title: Five-Star Clinic Tycoon
description: Turn a humble neighborhood clinic into a bustling five-star medical center—hire quirky doctors, unlock specialty wards, cure hilarious patients, and watch profits soar.
controls: Tap to build departments, upgrade medical beds, hire staff, and collect consultation earnings from cured patients.

zh-CN.title: 五星卫生院
zh-CN.description: 微信爆款模拟经营五星卫生院：把小小社区卫生站一步步扩建成五星医院，招募神医、扩建科室治病赚钱爽翻天！
zh-CN.controls: 点击扩建诊室与病床、招募医护人员接诊奇葩病人，赚取诊费升级打造五星医院。
